name: Passenger books a routed ride with profile contact
description: Verifies the main passenger booking flow uses the map, route search, profile phone contact, and durable client-side routing.
steps: Sign in as a passenger
Open Request a ride and allow GPS or use the pickup field
Enter a destination and find the route
Verify the profile phone is shown as the ride contact without a Book for someone else control
Confirm and request the ride
Refresh the application
expected: The Mapbox map and route are visible, the profile phone is the default contact, the ride is created as Requested, and the app remains on a valid screen after refresh.

name: Passenger edits ride contact and cancels once
covers: cancelled ride removed from active trips
description: Verifies a passenger can edit the contact number for one ride and that cancellation removes the ride from active passenger views.
steps: Open the booking screen
Edit the ride contact number and save the edit
Request a ride
Open the active trip and cancel it
Return to the rider home or Trips screen
Attempt to find the cancelled ride among active trips
expected: The edited contact is used for the ride, cancellation succeeds once, the ride is no longer an active trip, and the cancelled ride cannot be cancelled again from the passenger active flow.

name: Passenger sees a proper not-found page
description: Verifies an invalid client route produces a dedicated not-found screen instead of silently opening the workspace home.
steps: Sign in as a passenger
Navigate to an unknown route in the application hash
Observe the route result
Use the return action
expected: A dedicated 404 screen explains that the page was not found and provides a working return action.

name: Driver explicitly accepts or rejects a request
description: Verifies an authenticated verified driver can explicitly accept or reject a Requested ride without corrupting ride ownership.
steps: Sign in as a verified passenger and create a ride
Sign in as a verified online driver
Open Ride requests
Reject one request and confirm it disappears for that driver
Accept another Requested ride
expected: Rejecting records the driver rejection without cancelling the passenger ride, while accepting changes the selected ride to Accepted with the driver attached.

name: Passenger completes online Paystack payment and rates trip
description: Verifies a completed passenger ride can be paid online and rated once with durable state.
steps: Open a completed unpaid trip
Choose Pay online with Paystack
Complete the Paystack test checkout
Return to the Tridash trip route
Submit a 5-star rating with a short review
Attempt to submit another rating for the same ride
expected: Tridash verifies the exact fare and marks the payment Paid, the rating is saved once, the driver aggregate updates, and a duplicate rating is rejected.
